name: Kanyangi Water Pipeline Extension
description: Extending the piped water network to serve five villages currently relying on seasonal water pans.

name: Kisasi Market Sheds Upgrade
description: New roofed market sheds, drainage and a loading bay for farmers and traders at Kisasi market.

name: Mbitini Health Centre Maternity Wing
description: Construction of a maternity wing to reduce referrals to Kitui County Referral Hospital.

name: Kwa Vonza/Yatta Feeder Roads Grading
description: Grading and spot-gravelling of key feeder roads to improve access during the rainy season.

name: Kanyangi Primary School Classrooms
description: Two additional classrooms and a staff room; works paused pending release of the next funding tranche.

name: Mbitini Sand Dam Construction
description: A community sand dam to improve water retention and access for households and livestock.
